page.title: Field Reports
page.subtitle: MINISTRY UPDATES FROM ACROSS THE NETWORK
page.aboutLead: Every month, pastors and field staff submit updates from their communities — what changed, what was tried, and what is working. These reports are the narrative behind the numbers on country and community pages.
page.aboutBody: Monthly ministry reports, quarterly briefs, and annual summaries give partners and staff a grounded view of holistic ministry across the network. They capture pastoral visits, savings groups, agricultural trials, school support, and church life — not as isolated anecdotes, but as a consistent record of progress over time.
page.aboutClosing: Reports feed directly into the scorecard and totals you see on country pages. When you download a report, you are reading the same source material that shapes how we understand impact across Kenya, Malawi, Ethiopia, and the wider network.
page.mainMessagesLead: Field reports are more than paperwork — they connect pastoral work on the ground to the figures partners see online. Three ideas guide how we collect and use them.

mainMessages.title: From the field: Capture what pastors see every month
mainMessages.intro: Pastors know their communities. Monthly reports give them a structured way to record visits, projects, and outcomes — in their own words, from their own context.
points: Monthly reports cover holistic ministry: discipleship, savings, agriculture, education, and community care.
Quarterly briefs summarise trends across catchments and compare progress between countries.
Annual summaries pull the year together — impact metrics, programme highlights, and stories worth remembering.

mainMessages.title: Into the numbers: Reports feed the scorecard
mainMessages.intro: The totals on country and community pages do not appear from nowhere. They are built from the same field reports pastors submit each month.
points: Community counts, pastor numbers, and programme indicators are updated from verified field submissions.
Quarterly briefs highlight where networks are growing fastest and where support is needed.
Partners can trace a figure on the scorecard back to the narrative in the underlying report.

mainMessages.title: For partners: Download, read, and share
mainMessages.intro: Reports are written for staff, pastors, and partners who want the full picture — not just headlines.
points: Download any report in the archive below — monthly, quarterly, or annual.
Filter by country or report type to find what you need quickly.
Share reports with boards, donors, and prayer partners who want to see what is happening on the ground.
